news_impact.event_quantification: 7 stores × 700 units/month × 12 months × $6,200 avg new-car GPU (BTIG $5,500–$7,500 midpoint, cited in M0.6.3) = $366.0M/year gross profit. Cross-over demand substitution drag (75% of new-car buyers previously searched used, per BTIG data in M0.6.3): 0.75 × 7 × 700 × 12 × ($6,900 used GPU − $6,200 new GPU) = $30.9M/year foregone used-car GP. Net annual GP delta = $335.1M. After-tax at ~28% effective rate (inference; Carvana's incremental rate not separately disclosed): ΔE/yr = $335.1M × 0.72 = $241M/year. EPS revision: $241M ÷ 1,097M fully-diluted shares (derived from EV ~$75.4B and $65.90/share, M0.6.2) = +$0.22/share (+13.9% on $1.58 FY2026 consensus EPS, Web: Yahoo Finance/Zacks, ~July 10 2026, indicative, unverified). Net of $171M acquisition cost: ΔValue = ($241M × 41.7x forward P/E) − $171M = $9,879M (~$9.9B). [Carvana Q1 2026 8-K, SEC EDGAR, April 29 2026; CNBC, June 16 2026; The Motley Fool, July 11 2026]
news_impact.delta_value: ~$9.9B net of $171M acquisition consideration (capitalised at 41.7x forward P/E on $241M after-tax ΔE/yr, permanent step-change)
news_impact.caveats: Duration-trap check: not applicable (permanent step-change). Illustrative finite check: if misclassified as 3-year finite, NPV at 12% cost of equity = $578M → implied move +0.8% vs +13.9% capitalised — a 17x overstatement, confirming the recurrence call is load-bearing. Observed move is a range (−10% to −17%, midpoint ~−13.5%) due to price-source inconsistency between two web sources for June 16 2026 close ($64.23 vs $70.04); direction is unambiguous. The +13.9% fundamental implied move and −10% to −17% observed move point in opposite directions: the market ran the re-rate on GPU dilution and the Stellantis cap, not on the earnings addition. Gap = ~25–31% total, a multiple compression to be adjudicated by the research swarm. The 700 units/month is one store in one month; applying it to all 7 stores is an extrapolation the M0.5 falsifier (350 units/store/month) tests. GPU midpoint is a BTIG estimate, not from a Carvana filing. Gotham City Research allegations (January 2026) create a tail risk on the EPS consensus base. This is a fundamentals floor, not a verdict.
